violations.description: Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Three compartment sink was not maintained or operated in the approved three step method. Operate as follows: 1) Hot soapy water 2) Clear water rinse 3) Sanitizing rinse Air dry all utensils Ensure clear water rinse steps is accomplished before sanitizing rinse.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Unfinished wall construction at entryway to walk in cooler.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Mop stored in utility sink. Store in a position that allows air-drying.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Store single service items away from unprotected drain lines under FOH hand sink.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. Unfinished wall at walk in units.
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Cleaning frequency, maintained clean (1 pt deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
